original_interpretation: Synopsys FY2025 cost of revenue US$1.624bn; implied GAAP gross margin ~77%.
evidence_found: "Total cost of revenue | 654,663 | | 375,023 | | 1,623,549 | | 1,245,289" and "Gross margin | 1,600,197 | | 1,260,963 | | 5,430,629 | | 4,882,147" (Synopsys Q4 FY2025 release (news.synopsys.com), Unaudited Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income, Twelve Months Ended October 31, 2025 (US$ thousands)). 5,430,629/7,054,178 = 77.0%.

original_interpretation: Amkor customers generally do not commit to significant purchases or give binding demand forecasts.
evidence_found: "Generally, our customers do not commit to purchase any significant amount of packaging or test services or provide us with binding forecasts of demand for packaging and test services for any future period, in any material amount." (Amkor Form 10-K FY2025 (accession 0001047127-26-000014), Item 1A, risk factor 'The lack of contractually committed customer demand may materially and adversely affect our sales.')
notes: web_extract of sec.gov truncated before Item 1A and the browser is blocked by SEC. Verified by (a) SEC EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov) for the exact phrase "binding forecasts of demand" returning only amkr-20251231.htm in this filing, and (b) reading the passage in an insiderdelta.com reproduction of the same accession. Caveat for 2026: the July 2026 NVIDIA US$1.5bn prepayment deal suggests some customers now make firmer commitments; the 10-K wording remains as stated.

original_interpretation: Amkor describes operations as high fixed cost with no material backlog; utilisation significantly affects gross margins.

notes: Same method as CLM-0234: EDGAR full-text search for "absence of any material backlog" and "can significantly affect gross margins" both hit amkr-20251231.htm; passage read in insiderdelta.com reproduction of the same filing. Company self-description in risk factors; fact typing acceptable (wording 'describes' is accurate).
